resumen: Sin gestión: lo que pedían queda fuera de mi cometido

eventos.texto: Good morning, Clínica Arenal, you're through to reception. How can I help you today?
Hello, I'd like dermatology with doctora Iglesias, please.
Falta un segundo dato para confirmar quién es
Thanks. And to be sure I have the right record, could I have the DNI, or the date of birth?
Ese DNI no está en el directorio
Sin gestión · lo que pedían queda fuera de mi cometido
I can't find that number. Could you read me the DNI again, digit by digit, with the letter at the end?
